# Public release verification fixture

`SHA2-256SUMS` and its detached signature are unmodified assets from
https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/tag/2026.11.23, retrieved for offline
regression testing. They contain public release filenames and digests, not
secrets or media binaries. Their verification key is the pinned yt-dlp public
release key described in the security policy.
